bodyHtml.zh-CN:
产品改进

  • 新增社区 HagiTask 图库，支持来源管理、排序、安装元数据、稳定图标、原地升级和创建提案入口。
  • 新增预设任务的类型化与声明式输入、执行元数据、别名和仓库范围，并刷新任务契约。
  • 新增公开 HagiTask 链接和将对话转换为提案的能力，同时保留规划语言偏好。
  • 新增活动摘要和远程语音输入快照，并改进个人资料与会话状态展示。

问题修复

  • 改进提示词渲染、Markdown 会话导出、工具结果规范化和声明式输入绑定行为。
bodyHtml.en:
Product Improvements

  • Added a community HagiTask gallery with source management, ordering, installation metadata, stable icons, in-place upgrades, and proposal entry points.
  • Added typed and declarative preset-task inputs, execution metadata, aliases, repository scopes, and refreshed task contracts.
  • Added public HagiTask links and the ability to convert a conversation into a proposal while preserving planning-language preferences.
  • Added activity summaries, remote voice-input snapshots, and improved profile and session status surfaces.

Fixes

  • Improved prompt rendering, Markdown transcript export, tool-result normalization, and declarative input binding behavior.
